key_questions: Tom Kennedy (WR, DET) is ruled out. Is the market's price on his replacement's usage already reflecting the redistributed role, or still anchored to a committee?

2 skill players are Questionable (Amon-Ra St. Brown (WR), Aaron Jones Sr. (RB)). These resolve at the inactive release 90 minutes before kickoff — is any current price worth taking before that, or is the option value of waiting larger than the move you expect?
KXNFLGAME-26NOV01MINDET-DET moved +0.125 since first capture. Is that move explained by public injury news already in this packet, or is it information we do not have?

The model disagrees by -0.033 on KXNFLTOTAL-26NOV01MINDET-50 (TOTAL). Is that a mean disagreement the market has historically handled better, or a genuine shape difference? Note the model was shown redundant to the market on player props.

The model disagrees by +0.031 on KXNFLTEAMTOTAL-26NOV01MINDET-MIN4 (TEAM_TOTAL). Is that a mean disagreement the market has historically handled better, or a genuine shape difference? Note the model was shown redundant to the market on player props.

KXNFLTEAMTOTAL-26NOV01MINDET-MIN4 sits at a market price of 0.96 — a tail rung. The tail of the model's distribution is the least validated part of it. Is this rung relying on shape the model is known to miscalibrate?
